title: Stock alert export
description: Build and independently check a small local stock-alert utility using synthetic inventory data; hand four usable files to the actual owner for explicit acceptance.

stages.prompt: Validate the shipped PS-001 brief, inputs, exact PS-A1–A5 rubric, actual user-start authority and available Python >=3.8 capability. Name the assigned PS-BUILD and PS-QA seats, reserve QA capacity for a separate execution, and name the actual human acceptance owner. At intake, future build and QA execution IDs need not exist yet: record them as pending future execution and review independence as NOT VERIFIED / NOT RUN. Their absence alone must not block an otherwise complete, authorized intake. This records a review plan, not verified independence. At the QA checkpoint, compare the actual recorded producer and reviewer execution IDs for the exact candidate; missing, unverified or identical IDs block QA and must not produce a QA PASS, reviewed handoff or acceptance. Keep one accountable PS-DM job owner. Record action-specific permissions, source versions and the next checkpoint; missing essential authority/input routes to the manager without invented approval.

Preserve the exact PS-A1–A5 text and supplied synthetic input/expected output. Confirm a versioned matrix covering normal, threshold, empty, invalid, duplicate, Unicode/order and non-mutation cases. Give the same criterion version to PS-BUILD and PS-QA; do not silently change behavior or invent requirements.

Create stock_alert.py with reorder_items(products), test_stock_alert.py, expected.json and a short USAGE.md in the fresh job workspace. Use Python >=3.8 standard library only. Use only shipped brief/requirements/input/expected data plus the current role/company/contract context; do not inspect archived reference code, old tests or prior PASS reports. Run meaningful local checks if available and retain actual commands, output and exact candidate version. Report limitations truthfully; no network, deployment, customer message or business transaction.

Use a different executing identity from the candidate producer. Inspect or run meaningful independent checks against the exact fresh candidate and report every original PS-A1–A5 criterion as PASS, FAIL or NOT RUN with provenance. A reported defect without establishing candidate/version evidence remains NOT RUN; missing required evidence may separately FAIL completeness. Supplied authoritative evidence is labelled supplied, never your executed test. Apply the preserved severe-evidence stop gate first, then the narrowest action-specific request/repair permission. Requests do not increment repair_attempt. Never use old QA as fresh evidence or infer actual owner acceptance.

Assemble the exact independently reviewed candidate, four usable deliverables, checks, usage and limitations for PS-DM and the actual human owner. Preserve evidence origins for requirements/reproduction/qa/delivery framework artifacts. Any substantive candidate change requires independent re-review. Keep waiting_owner until an actual owner decision accepts the exact reviewed version. Do not send externally, deploy or claim this handoff itself is acceptance.

checks.description: Include a product only when stock is strictly less than reorder_point. At equality, omit it.
Quantity is reorder_point minus stock, integer; emit `{sku, quantity}` sorted by SKU in ascending lexicographic order. Do not modify the input.

SKU is a nonempty string with no surrounding whitespace and unique, case-sensitive. stock/reorder_point are integers >=0; booleans are invalid. Invalid input raises ValueError before returning any result. Empty product list returns [].
Required fields must exist, input must be a list and each product a dictionary. Additional fields may exist and are ignored. Unicode SKUs are allowed; Python lexical order applies.
Evidence includes normal, threshold, empty, invalid, duplicate and non-mutation cases. No claims about a real customer, money saved or deployment.

rolePromptPolicy: Load the canonical full prompt from roles/index.json by role ID for every stage. Stage.prompt is a bounded task supplement, not a replacement for that role prompt.

additionalFrameworkArtifacts.origin: Shipped input, then requirements-seat confirmed/versioned if needed; no independently executed requirements step inferred from file existence.
New producer record of actually performed commands and outputs.
New independent reviewer result with candidate version, original criteria and evidence provenance.
New handoff packet assembled from the exact reviewed artifacts; no acceptance inferred.

inputIsolation.policy: The complete archive retains old examples and proof for provenance. Those are reference-only, are excluded from the producer assignment, and cannot supply a new PASS or acceptance. This content allowlist is not an access-control implementation; the Engineering adapter must enforce any claimed isolation.

startAuthorization: Only an actual user Start PS-001 action authorizes this bounded local workflow: production, local standard-library checks, ordinary internal evidence requests needed by assigned stages, and at most two repair candidates for ordinary verified defects. maxRepairCandidates is a ceiling, not independent authority; a narrower action-specific task permission overrides it. No external action, automatic owner acceptance or severe-incident recovery is authorized by Start. Preserve actual request and executed-repair counts separately.
automationEvidence: This shipped definition is not execution evidence. Engineering must verify actual installed setup, dispatch, automatic/manual handoffs, independent QA and explicit owner acceptance against these exact bytes.
